newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes flat, loses early edge.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes flat, loses early edge.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka lost its early edge and closed flat at 42.8200/8300 to the dollar in interbank trading on Saturday, dealers said.

The local unit was quoted firmer at 42.8000/8300 per dollar in early trade but lost following some unexpected midday purchases, said one dealer. "Initially we expected a typically dull Saturday market. But one bank turned up unexpectedly in the middle of the session with a significant demand (for dollars)", he said.
The call money rates finished at 9.5 to 10 percent against the previous 8.0-9.0 percent. Friday is the weekend in Bangladesh.
